remediation_applied: Superseded and closed by F-040: the 'aud' validator was unsatisfiable against the provisioned realm (no audience mapper), so the fleet now validates the 'azp' claim through shop.security.expected-client-ids, which is populated with the realm's actual client ids in common-spring's shared defaults and in the gateway's gateway.security.expected-client-ids. The 'aud' path is retained but documented as requiring an audience mapper first.
verification_evidence: common-security: 4 new unit tests in BaseSecurityConfigClientIdValidationTest; gateway: 3 new unit tests in GatewayJwtSecurityConfigTest.

remediation_applied: New Liquibase changeset inventory-service/changelog-004 adds CHECK (available_quantity >= 0) and CHECK (reserved_quantity >= 0) as NOT VALID (enforced for new/updated rows, no table lock, no failure on legacy rows). InventoryServiceImpl.commit() and release() now reject an arithmetic outcome that would go negative with BusinessException STOCK_INSUFFICIENT instead of writing it. The atomic reserve/release statements guard the same invariant in SQL.
verification_evidence: inventory-service: 2 new unit tests (commit_rejectsNegativeStockOutcome, release_rejectsNegativeStockOutcome) + the InventoryLifecycleIdempotencyTest against real PostgreSQL with the new schema.

remediation_applied: New Liquibase changeset adds reservations.version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and the Reservation entity gains @Version. The expiry sweep no longer performs an unlocked SELECT + blind save: it CLAIMS each row with a conditional UPDATE (status = PENDING -> EXPIRED, version + 1) and only moves stock for the rows it actually claimed. The inventory decrement is an atomic guarded UPDATE (reservedQuantity >= qty) that can never over-credit.
verification_evidence: inventory-service: new unit tests sweep_claimsExpiredRowsAndReleasesReservedQuantity, sweep_skipsRowsAlreadyClaimedByAnotherWriter (the F-011 lost-update regression), sweep_publishesReleasedEventForEachExpiredReservation.

remediation_applied: ReservationCleanupScheduler now publishes an inventory.released.v1 outbox row (previousStatus=PENDING) for every expired reservation it claims, in the same transaction as the stock movement.

ReservationServiceImpl.sleep() now returns false when the thread was interrupted; the retry loop restores the interrupt flag and aborts with INVENTORY_VERSION_CONFLICT instead of continuing to spin on a dead thread.
verification_evidence: inventory-service module test suite green (ReservationServiceImplTest included).

remediation_applied: shop.kafka.consumer.auto-offset-reset changed from 'latest' to 'earliest' in all seven Kafka-consuming services (media, notification, order, payment, product, search, shipping), so a consumer group replays the events it missed instead of skipping them.
verification_evidence: Full reactor build green; the integration suites that override the property to 'earliest' already matched the new default.

remediation_applied: order-service: shop.services.payment.enabled now defaults to true (was false). A new PaymentGateValidator fails the application context at startup when the payment integration is disabled while order.payment-gate.require-captured-payment is true (default), so the dangerous combination can no longer be reached silently. PaymentServiceClient.refundByOrderId no longer reports success when the client is disabled.
verification_evidence: order-service: new integration test confirm_withoutCapturedPayment_failsClosedWithOrd4012 asserts the gate fails closed with ORD-4012 and the order stays PENDING; the 7 pre-existing ConfirmOrchestrationIT tests were updated to stub a CAPTURED payment and are green.

remediation_applied: order-service: shop.services.keycloak.client-secret no longer defaults to the literal 'changeme'; the default is empty, which makes the client_credentials exchange fail closed instead of succeeding with a well-known secret.

WebhookSignatureVerifier now catches IllegalArgumentException from HexFormat.parseHex in the Stripe-style branch, so a 64-character non-hex v1 value is rejected as an invalid signature (401) instead of escaping as a 500 on an unauthenticated endpoint.

gateway-service: server.forward-headers-strategy changed from 'framework' to 'none' so the gateway resolves the client IP itself from the raw X-Forwarded-For chain; gateway.rate-limit.trusted-proxy-hops now defaults to 1 (was 0). A new GatewaySecurityPostureValidator refuses to start when trusted-proxy-hops is 0 while a forwarded-header strategy other than 'none' is active.
verification_evidence: gateway-service: new unit tests GatewaySecurityPostureValidatorTest (5 cases) cover the wildcard-CORS and zero-hop rejections.

remediation_applied: gateway-service: new GatewayJwtSecurityConfig declares a ReactiveJwtDecoder with the same validator chain the servlet stack uses (issuer + timestamp + azp), so the edge now rejects a token minted for a client it does not accept. Previously the edge used Boot's reactive auto-configuration (issuer + timestamp only).
verification_evidence: gateway-service: new unit test GatewayJwtSecurityConfigTest (3 cases) including the issuer-mismatch case.

remediation_applied: gateway-service: GatewaySecurityPostureValidator refuses to start when gateway.cors-allowed-origin-patterns contains '*' while the gateway's CORS configuration enables allowCredentials(true). The shipped .env.example wildcard remains a configuration mistake that now fails the deployment instead of silently enabling cross-origin data theft.
